messages:
rachel: Quick report -- our checkout service started failing strict-mypy after consumers bumped python-sdk to 0.9.0. Errors point at assignments from resp dicts into generated models.

james: can you paste the exact error?

rachel: CI snippet:

```
services/checkout/client.py:47: error: Expression of type "str" cannot be assigned to declared type "Optional[str]"  [assignment]
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 31 source files)
```

rachel: client does `order.description = resp['description']` where generated model has `description: Optional[str] = None`. Previously responses were TypedDicts so this didn't trigger.

sergio: thanks. this matches an internal change: models moved to Pydantic BaseModel but we didn't keep TypedDicts for response shapes. three paths: 1) re-emit TypedDict responses, 2) widen model fields to Any, 3) add generator flag to opt into typed responses, 4) add mypy plugin.

james: (2) and (4) feel wrong. (1) preferred but potentially breaking. (3) seems safe: an opt-in `--typed-responses` flag so teams can adopt when ready.

rachel: +1 for the flag. also noticed embedding fields are List[Any] -> would be great if numeric embeddings became List[float] when schema says numbers.

sergio: good call. plan: implement `--typed-responses` that emits TypedDicts for operation responses and updates client stubs to use them. Add heuristic: items.type == "number" -> List[float]; integer -> List[int]; else Any. Also add `from __future__ import annotations` in generated modules.

james: will that help pyright too? many devs use pyright in editors.

sergio: yes TypedDicts are understood by both mypy and pyright. I’ll include a small mypy.ini and pyrightconfig.json in samples.

rachel: please include an async sample in samples/ showing AsyncClient consuming typed responses. lots of teams want examples with async + typed responses + mypy config.

sergio: yep. sample will live at samples/async_typed_example.py and demonstrate `async with RedwoodAsyncClient() as c:` importing generated TypedDicts and showing one call. I’ll also add a tiny test that runs mypy and pyright over the sample.

devx-bot: Branch pushed: feature/typed-responses (repo: python-sdk)

james: for short-term unblockers we patched callers with `from typing import cast, Optional` and `order.description = cast(Optional[str], resp.get('description'))` -- ugly but works.

rachel: correct, but we shouldn't surface that to users. would prefer SDK fix before we tell others to cast widely.

sergio: plan for release: opt-in flag in 0.9.x patch, docs & changelog entry, flip default in 1.0.0. ETA: WIP PR later today with tests. Will post link here when available.

james: please ping when PR is up, happy to help add CI job that runs both mypy and pyright.

rachel: thanks all. this will help teams that enforce strict typing. :thumbsup:
